title: Print Numbers from 1 to N
description: Print all numbers from 1 to N, each on a new line.
constraints: Read an integer N from input. Print numbers from 1 to N.
explanation: For input 5, numbers 1 to 5 are printed each on a new line.

title: Sum of First N Natural Numbers
description: Compute and print the sum of the first N natural numbers.
constraints: Read an integer N from input. Print the sum.

title: Print Multiplication Table
description: Print the multiplication table of a given number up to 10.
constraints: Read an integer M from input. Print M*1 to M*10, one per line.
explanation: For input 3, the multiplication table from 1 to 10 is printed.

title: Count Odd and Even Numbers
description: Read N numbers and print how many are odd and how many are even.
constraints: Read an integer N, then N numbers. Print counts of odd and even.
explanation: For input 1 2 3 4 5, there are 3 odd and 2 even numbers.

title: Sum Until Zero
description: Keep reading integers and add them until a zero is entered. Print the sum.
constraints: Read numbers from input until 0 is entered. Print the sum.
explanation: The sum of 4+2+(-3) is 3. Input ends when 0 is read.

title: Reverse an Array
description: Read N numbers into an array and print them in reverse order.
constraints: Read an integer N, then N numbers. Print them in reverse order, space-separated.

title: Prime Numbers in a Range
description: Print all prime numbers between L and R (inclusive), each on a new line.
constraints: Read two integers L and R. Print all primes between them.

title: Find the First Repeated Number
description: Read N numbers and print the first number that repeats. If none, print -1.
constraints: Read an integer N, then N numbers. Print first repeated number, or -1 if none.
explanation: 5 is the first number that appears more than once.

title: Pattern Printing: Pyramid
description: Print a pyramid pattern of stars with N rows.
constraints: Read an integer N. Print N-row pyramid of stars.
explanation: For N=3, the pyramid is printed as shown.

title: Average of Positive Numbers
description: Keep reading numbers until a negative is entered. Print the average of all positive numbers (rounded down).
constraints: Read numbers until a negative is entered. Print the average of all positive numbers (integer division).
